sara: Hey team — billing flag from customer INV-2026-09. Dashboard shows ~120k tokens for their app in last 24h but invoice line is ~95k. Looks like a gap tied to streaming responses / client disconnects. Anyone seen this pattern?

ben_support: Can you paste an example request + correlation_id? Also which region and model?

sara: Sure. Region: eu-central-1, model: rdx-4o. Correlation: corr-47a3. Example client code (SSE):
```http
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.com
Accept: text/event-stream
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json

{ "prompt": "...", "stream": true }
```
Client dropped connection at ~8s (user navigated away). Server logs show stream ended with client_disconnect. Metering log for that session: 
```
[2026-11-03T14:22:11Z] session=corr-47a3 stream_end client_disconnect tokens_reported=412
[2026-11-03T14:22:12Z] finalizer running for session=corr-47a3 tokens_finalized=0
```
Dashboard shows ~412 tokens for this session, invoice shows 0.

carlos_eng: Hmm. Can you also include the internal metering id? If not, I can run a query by correlation_id. As a quick check, try this internal query (pseudo):
```sql
SELECT session_id, end_reason, tokens_reported, tokens_finalized, finalized_at
FROM metering.streams
WHERE correlation_id = 'corr-47a3';
```

jess_billing: Quick note: our billing pipeline currently aggregates tokens from sessions where end_reason = 'done' and from 'finalized' records. Canceled sessions historically get reconciled to a separate bucket, but there may be mismatch between realtime dashboard (estimates emitted during stream) and invoice (post-processed finalizer output). Is the customer saying invoices are lower than dashboard, or higher?

sara: Both, oddly. Most examples are dashboard > invoice (like corr-47a3) but we have a few cases where invoice > dashboard. One hypothesis: when the client disconnects mid-stream, we emit an interim token estimate to the dashboard, but the background finalizer can either drop that session (0) or double-count if it retries. I found a log snippet for another session where finalizer ran twice around a worker restart: 
```
[2026-11-04T03:11:01Z] finalizer start session=sess-99 tokens_to_add=300
[2026-11-04T03:11:01Z] finalizer error transient, worker=wm-12
[2026-11-04T03:11:05Z] finalizer start session=sess-99 tokens_to_add=300
[2026-11-04T03:11:05Z] finalizer success tokens_added=300
```
If the first job didn't mark in-progress properly, a later retry might add the tokens again (invoice > dashboard).

carlos_eng: That looks like a race: finalizer uses a lock but lock acquisition isn't idempotent on failure path. For client_disconnect path we also currently emit a dashboard event with "estimate_tokens" but we don't persist a durable checkpoint until finalizer runs. So dashboard shows the estimate, finalizer should persist final count — unless a retry path 0s it out or adds it twice. I'll open a short investigation PR to: (1) mark finalizer attempts with a unique run_id and atomic upsert, (2) ensure client_disconnect events persist a soft-checkpoint so invoice pipeline sees the same value.

ben_support: For escalation, what repro steps do you need? Customer is pushing this as billing impact.

sara: Steps to repro locally:
1) Start SSE request, let it stream ~400 tokens.
2) Force client TCP FIN at t+8s (simulated cancel).
3) Kill finalizer worker while it processes finalize job to simulate transient error, then bring it back so retry happens.
4) Compare dashboard token estimate vs finalized records and invoice export.

Please escalate with priority P2 -> billing impact. I've created an internal ticket INC-5892 for customer follow-up.

jess_billing: Assigned INC-5892. Need: metering dump for corr-47a3 and affected window (2026-11-03T14:00 -> 2026-11-04T04:00). Endpoint: POST /internal/metering/dump with {"correlation_id":"corr-47a3","window":"..."}. Also please include invoice export row IDs.

deploy-bot: [automated] Created ticket INC-5892 and linked to billing queue.

carlos_eng: I'll prototype a fix and add a reconciler job that dedupes finalize events by session_id+run_id before export. Also adding extra tracing so we can match dashboard estimate events -> finalizer runs. Once patch is out, please test against the repro steps and share the metering dump.

sara: OK will run repro and upload dump to INC-5892. Will tag @jess_billing and include affected invoice rows. Thanks — prioritizing now. :pray:
